recipes.name: Curry Lentil Soup
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over high heat. Cook the onion until golden, about 5 minutes. Add splashes of water as needed to deglaze the pan.
Then add garlic and the spices, and cook for another 2 minutes.
Add the remaining soup ingredients. Simmer, partially covered, for 15 minutes or until the lentils and potatoes are cooked.
Optionally, for a creamier texture, use an immersion blender to purée some of the soup. Then add the lemon juice.
Garnish as desired, serve hot and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Storage Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 4 days. Store in the freezer for up to 2 months.
